text:
```yaml
name: Windows E2E

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  e2e-windows:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
          cache-dependency-path: go.sum

      - name: Set up mise
        uses: jdx/mise-action@v1
        with:
          version: latest

      - name: Run fmt and lint
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          mise run fmt
          mise run lint

      - name: Run E2E tests
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          mise run e2e

      - name: Notify Slack on failure
        if: failure()
        uses: slackapi/slack-github-action@v1
        env:
          SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}
        with:
          channel: '#ci'
          text: ':x: Windows E2E tests failed in ${{ github.repository }} - ${{ github.workflow }} #${{ github.run_number }}'
          color: danger
```
